title: Two Paths of Destiny
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji was digesting the truth about his mother, an urgent warning suddenly came from the depths of the Tianji Record—someone had found the entrance to this place.

text.content: The golden light suddenly emanating from the depths of the Tianji Record cast Chen Ji's face in alternating brightness and shadow. That urgent warning pierced his soul like a fine needle. The truth about his mother still churned in his heart, and now complications arose. He slowly opened his eyes, and in those eyes that had always been as still as dead water, a rare cold gleam appeared. The aura coming from the entrance was all too familiar to him—that was the unique spiritual energy fluctuation of the Tianqing Sect. The visitor meant trouble.

Chen Ji did not act rashly. He slowly tucked the Tianji Record Fragment into his sleeve, his fingertips gently stroking the yellowed paper surface, as if bidding farewell to an old friend. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembled slightly on the first page, as if having countless words to say, yet sealed by some forbidden restriction. A self-deprecating arc appeared at the corner of Chen Ji's mouth—this chess game, he had played for seven volumes, and in the end, he could not even become the chess player.

Footsteps approached, each step measured and precise. The visitor clearly mastered the Tianqing Sect's 'Stepping Cloud Stride', yet with a deliberate hint of ostentation mixed in. Chen Ji lowered his gaze, already making his calculations—in the entire Tianqing Sect, no more than five people could find this place at this moment. And those willing to make such a grand show of it were even fewer. The possibility of that old fox Ling Yuan flashed through his mind.

'Chen Junior Brother, you certainly know how to pick places.' A cold female voice sounded at the stone door, carrying an indescribably complex undertone. 'I followed the traces you left for three months, and finally found this place.' Chen Ji's gaze shifted slightly. Su Qingyao. He had expected Ling Yuan himself, but never imagined it would be her. However, thinking about it, given that Inner Disciple Senior Fellow's keenness, tracking here was within reason.

dialogue.content: I know you're in there. Su Qingyao's voice pierced through the stone door, carrying a rare weariness. 'Something happened outside. Han Lie of the Xuanwu Sect led people to surround the Tianqing Sect Mountain Gate, and Chief Ling... he disappeared.' She paused. 'The sect is in chaos, and I came to find you.'

text.content: Chen Ji did not answer immediately. His consciousness sank into the depths of the Tianji Record, and on that yellowed fragment, golden characters were slowly emerging. This was the final guidance left by Mo Xiansheng—the description of the two paths, every word weighing like a thousand tons. The First Path: Sever the shackles of heaven's mandate, returning destiny to虚无. The Second Path: Take its place, become the new chess player. Two paths, leading to utterly different destinations.

The First Path meant completely overturning the calculations of the Eye of Heavenly Mandate, returning the world's rules to chaos. The fate of mortals would no longer be manipulated, but they would have to bear the cost of losing order. Chen Ji gazed at those characters, and a bitterness surged in his heart—this path, his mother had paved with her life. She hid the Tianji Record Fragment in his body, wagering that someday he would walk here.

The Second Path required replacing the Eye of Heavenly Mandate with his own body, becoming that transcendent consciousness. This path was equally perilous—every prophet throughout history had walked to this step,无一例外地 failing, becoming nourishment for heaven's mandate. But once successful, he would possess the power to rewrite fate, not only for himself, but for Chen Nian, for all the chess pieces manipulated by heaven's mandate.

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's voice drifted from the depths of the fragment, carrying a solemnity never seen before. 'The choice is yours, Chen Ji. But no matter which path you choose, remember—the Tianji Record never belonged to heaven's mandate. It was once a tool used by ancient sages to combat emptiness. Now that it has fallen into your hands, it is both fortune and calamity.'

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, and memories flooded back like a tide. Seven volumes of time, he had walked the martial world as a waste, manipulating the three great sects at will, seemingly glorious yet步步惊心 at every turn. Every glimpse of the future consumed five Heavenly Fate points, and now he had almost none remaining. Ye Qing's Demonic Path fog had helped mask his presence, Su Qingyao's investigations had been resolved by him again and again, Ling Yuan's secret harms had been turned against him... along this journey, which of these had not舔着刀尖上的血?

He thought of Chen Nian's eyes clouded by the Holy Sect, of his mother's words before death—'Live on'—of the blurry prophetic visions on the Tianji Record Fragment—Chen Nian's, Su Qingyao's, his own. Every glimpse of their futures made him more certain: this chess game, he cannot lose. But now, he must choose his own piece on the board.

choice.prompt: Two paths of destiny lie before Chen Ji, and he must make a choice—

choices.description: Sever the shackles of heaven's mandate, returning destiny to emptiness. This path is his mother's dying wish, and the most thorough rebellion against heaven's mandate. The cost is the loss of all existing order, and the world will fall into chaos.
choices.visible_cost: Lose all power granted by the Tianji Record
choices.visible_reward: Completely break free from heaven's mandate manipulation, gaining true freedom
choices.risk_hint: Chaos means the unknown, possibly rebirth, possibly destruction

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, his fingertips tracing across the Tianji Record Fragment. Mo Xiansheng's voice sounded again, carrying a hint of relief: 'Are you certain? Breaking the shackles means a complete break with heaven's mandate. Should you fail, you will be destroyed body and spirit, with even no chance of rebirth.' Chen Ji did not answer, only taking out the Jade Pendant his mother had left him from his chest—that was his only memento, his final reliance.

choices.description: Become the new chess player, controlling the threads of destiny. This path is the most perilous, as every prophet throughout history has failed here. But upon success, he will possess the power to rewrite everything.
choices.visible_cost: Consume all Heavenly Fate points, engaging in a direct confrontation with heaven's mandate's will
choices.visible_reward: Become the new heaven's mandate, controlling the direction of all worldly fates
choices.risk_hint: The Eye of Heavenly Mandate will not stand by idly—this will be a life-and-death battle spanning time and space

text.content: The Tianji Record Fragment suddenly grew scalding hot, golden characters frantically jumping, as if sensing Chen Ji's will. Mo Xiansheng fell silent for a moment, then sighed faintly: 'Replacing heaven's mandate... this path is even harder. Not only must you combat the Eye of Heavenly Mandate, you must also endure the loneliness and emptiness that comes with becoming it. Are you certain?' Chen Ji gazed at those characters, and a rare ambition flickered in his eyes: 'I never fight battles without certainty. This time, I will be the chess player.'

The moment Chen Ji made his choice, a dull roar echoed from the depths of the Tianji Record. That was the will of the Eye of Heavenly Mandate—it had sensed Chen Ji's decision, watching him in some transcending time and space manner. An invisible pressure descended from above, as if the entire heavens and earth were rejecting this mortal who dared to defy heaven and change fate. Yet the corner of Chen Ji's mouth curved into a cold smile: 'Good timing.'

dialogue.content: Beyond the stone door, Su Qingyao's voice sounded again, this time with a hint of anxiety: 'Chen Ji, are you actually in there? The pursuers outside are already less than thirty li away. If you don't come out, I'll force my way in!' Her tone was rarely lacking in composure. 'I don't know what you're doing in there, but I know... you cannot die here.'

text.content: Chen Ji snapped back to reality. He put away the Tianji Record Fragment and slowly walked toward the stone door. Mo Xiansheng's voice echoed in his mind: 'No matter which path you choose, time is needed. And for now... your beloved seems to have run into trouble.' Chen Ji did not answer, only pushing the stone door. The heavy door slowly opened under his palm, revealing Su Qingyao's face, slightly flushed with anxiety. She remained as cold and otherworldly as ever, yet that trace of worry in her eyes could not be faked.

dialogue.content: 'Senior Sister Su.' Chen Ji's voice returned to its usual plainness, as if that moment of struggle had never happened. 'You said something happened outside?' He paused, his gaze sweeping past Su Qingyao in a certain direction. 'Pursuers thirty li away? It seems Chief Ling truly cannot sit still anymore.' His tone revealed neither joy nor anger, only in those deep eyes, a chilling light that would startle anyone flickered briefly.

Su Qingyao looked at this man she had been investigating for seven volumes, her heart filled with mixed emotions. She still did not know why he always managed to turn danger into safety at critical moments, did not know where those seemingly废物 yet actually flawless methods came from. But at this moment, she chose to trust him. 'Chief Ling has colluded with the Xuanwu Sect, intending to eliminate you through Han Lie's hands.' She took a deep breath. 'You... what exactly did you do, to make him so fearful?'

text.content: Chen Ji did not answer directly. He gazed at the sky beyond the ruins, where dark clouds gathered and thunder rumbled distantly. The news Su Qingyao brought confirmed his suspicions—Ling Yuan truly could not sit still anymore. That old fox he had been secretly suppressing for seven volumes was finally showing his fangs. What was laughable was that the other party thought this was his weakness, not knowing this was part of his布局. 'Senior Sister Su,' Chen Ji turned to look at her, his eyes flickering with unprecedented seriousness, 'are you willing to trust me?'

Su Qingyao was stunned for a moment. It was the first time she had heard Chen Ji speak to her in such a tone. That Servant Disciple who always appeared as a废物, always submissive, now actually possessed an unstoppable momentum. She thought of the various events over these seven volumes, of every time she had gotten infinitely close to the truth only to be skillfully resolved by him, and suddenly smiled. 'I chased you for three years,' she said softly, 'if I couldn't trust you, why would I have chased you this far?'

Upon hearing this, a trace of warmth imperceptible to others flickered in Chen Ji's eyes. This was the first person to actively choose to stand by his side since he began arranging the world for seven volumes. He did not say much, only taking out a jade talisman from his sleeve and placing it in Su Qingyao's hand. 'This is my backup plan.' His voice was low. 'Ling Yuan and Han Lie think they can encircle and kill me, but they don't know... the true hunter often appears as prey.' The moment his words fell, rumbling hoofbeats sounded outside the ruins—the pursuers had arrived.
